# Tatton Projects

> Tatton Projects is an owner-managed construction contractor based in Altrincham, Cheshire. It delivers commercial fit-out and refurbishment UK-wide, and new build homes, housing developments and major home extensions across Greater Manchester and Cheshire. 110+ projects and £8m delivered since 2020.

- Owner-managed: the person who priced the job is the person managing it on site. Founded in 2020 by Dave Groom (founder and contracts manager).
- Builds around live operations: care homes, hotels, surgeries, restaurants, shops and occupied offices that stay open during the works.
- Accreditations and memberships: Federation of Master Builders, Constructionline Gold, CITB, CSCS.
- Areas: Manchester, Altrincham, Sale, Timperley, Hale, Bowdon, Trafford, Stockport, Knutsford, Wilmslow, Alderley Edge, Macclesfield, Chester and the rest of Greater Manchester and Cheshire; commercial fit-out and refurbishment anywhere in the UK.
- Contact: 0161 706 2907 · info@tattonprojects.co.uk · Suite 15, Peel House, 30 The Downs, Altrincham WA14 2PX
- Google Business Profile: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=5824344195692267786 · Leave a review: https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/review
- A Tatton Holdings company.
- Sister company: Tatton Project Management Ltd (https://www.tattonprojects.com), an independent project management consultancy at 12-14 Shaws Road, Altrincham. Tatton Projects builds; Tatton Project Management manages projects. Clients can appoint either on its own or both together.

## Services

- [Office fit-out, Manchester](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/office-fit-out-manchester): Cat A and Cat B office fit-out across Manchester and the North West, with selected projects nationwide.
- [Shopfitting, Manchester](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/shopfitting-manchester): Retail fit-out and shopfitting, from strip-out and enabling works to a finished, trading store.
- [Commercial refurbishment, Manchester](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/commercial-refurbishment-manchester): Refurbishment of workplaces and commercial property, including EPC and MEES upgrades for landlords.
- [New build homes, Cheshire](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/new-build-homes-cheshire): One-off new build houses from £400k to £3m+, across Cheshire and Greater Manchester.
- [Extension builders, Altrincham](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/extension-builders-altrincham): Major extensions and whole-house remodels in Altrincham, Hale, Bowdon and Cheshire.
- [Extension builders, Hale](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/extension-builders-hale): Substantial home extensions and whole-house remodelling in Hale.
- [Builders in Altrincham](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/builders-altrincham): Owner-managed building contractor based on The Downs, Altrincham: extensions, renovations, basements, new builds and office fit-out across Altrincham, Hale, Bowdon and Timperley.
- [Builders in Sale](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/builders-sale): Owner-managed building contractor ten minutes from Sale: extensions, whole-house renovations, cellar conversions and office fit-out across Sale, Brooklands, Ashton upon Mersey and Sale Moor.
- [Builders in Timperley](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/builders-timperley): Extensions and remodels of 1930s semis and detached houses, whole-house renovations and new homes in Timperley, Brooklands and Wellgreen, five minutes from the office.
- [Construction company, Manchester](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/builders-manchester): Office fit-out, commercial refurbishment and shopfitting across Manchester, and house extensions and renovations in Didsbury, Chorlton and south Manchester.
- [Builders in Cheshire](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/builders-cheshire): One-off new homes, major extensions and whole-house renovations across Hale, Bowdon, Wilmslow, Knutsford, Alderley Edge, Mobberley, Lymm and Prestbury.
- [House renovations, Altrincham](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/house-renovations-altrincham): Whole-house renovation and remodelling in Altrincham, Hale and Bowdon.
- [Basement conversions, Altrincham](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/basement-conversions-altrincham): Underpinning, tanking and finished rooms below ground in Altrincham, Hale and Bowdon.
- [Office fit-out, Altrincham](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/office-fit-out-altrincham): Cat A and Cat B office fit-out and refurbishment for businesses in Altrincham and south Manchester.
- [Housing developments and land, Cheshire](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/housing-developments-cheshire): Small and medium schemes of two to thirty plots, with or without planning consent. Tatton also buys sites and joint-ventures with landowners, with a free site appraisal in five working days.

- [Site walkthrough videos](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/walkthroughs): Video walkthroughs of live and completed projects — basement conversions in Hale, Cat B office fit-outs in Liverpool, new build housing developments across Cheshire. Published at handover.

- [Stockport service centre](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/work/stockport-service-centre): £175K fit-out of a public-facing service floor with ninety-plus staffed positions that never closed for a day (2025).
